_comment: Copy this to your instance folder as config.json and fill it in. This file (the example) stays in the repo with NO real data. Your filled config.json lives in your private instance layer, never in the repo.

handles.chat: <your chat user id, e.g. Slack member id>

storage.instancePath: <absolute path to your instance folder, e.g. ~/Vault/Work/_decoder>
storage.knowledgePath: <absolute path to your knowledge vault, e.g. ~/Vault/Work>

_ledger_comment: backend selects the promise store. 'builtin' (default) = state.json, the only store ADHDecoder writes. 'obsidian' = the optional read-only Obsidian adapter (adapters/obsidian); it also accepts any deprecated legacy backend value as an alias.
_sources_comment: weight (high|medium|low, default medium) sets sweep order/depth and is a tiebreak in surfacing; cadence (every-run|daily|hourly, default every-run) sets how often. See reference/scheduling.md. Tune per source, e.g. chat high/every-run, issues low/daily. Optional per-source keys (see reference/parity-port.md): tz (the source's own timezone for correct since-cutoff filtering, e.g. issues/crm) and noise (a known recurring bulk-sync/no-activity pattern to ignore, e.g. a nightly bump time).

schedule.boardPath: <path to the HTML dashboard written each run, e.g. ~/Vault/Work/Decoder Board.html; unset = print to chat only>
